summary: Amazon's editors published their best books of 2026 list, a big holiday driver for book links.
LTK shared holiday search data showing shoppers planning gifts and outfits earlier than usual.
CineD reports new YouTube Partner Program rules that make monetisation harder.
Draft2Digital (Books2Read) was active at Author Nation, focused on publishing wide.
Lasso, URLgenius and Button/Posttap were quiet.

items.title: The best books of 2026, according to the Amazon Editors
items.why: Amazon's yearly best-books list drives a lot of holiday book buying, so expect book link traffic to follow it.

items.title: Amazon ranks No. 1 on Forbes’ list of America’s Best Companies for 2027
LTK search data shows holiday shoppers planning early
items.why: LTK says holiday searches started early this year (e.g. 'Christmas party dress' up 75% week over week in mid-October), a sign creator shopping is starting sooner.

items.title: YouTube Makes Monetization Harder – New Partner Program Rules Explained
items.why: Stricter YouTube Partner Program rules affect which creators can earn on YouTube, including through Shopping.
